CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_kyc_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.full_name IS NOT NULL AND NEW.full_name != '' AND 
       NEW.phone_number IS NOT NULL AND NEW.phone_number != '' THEN
        NEW.kyc_status = 'APPROVED'; -- Changed from 'ACTIVE'
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
